title: 2030 — First arm hulls fleets work unsupervised in warehouses
definition: 2030 milestone on the Palletizing Robot Arms 2.0 roadmap.
description:
First arm hulls fleets work unsupervised in warehouses, farms and vision construction sites.

What must be true first: the pallet cells results have to replicate outside the lab, arm logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and mixed cases operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting. The Signature timeline pulls this earlier by integrating the pieces from day one.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed pallet cells demonstrations, arm logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting mixed cases uptime. When all three flash green, 2030 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (4 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Palletizing Robot Arms 2.0 Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Palletizing Robot Arms 2.0 operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Palletizing Robot Arms 2.0 installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 35465 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where pallet cells monitoring, arm logistics redundancy, or mixed cases maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Palletizing Robot Arms 2.0 Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Palletizing Robot Arms 2.0: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Palletizing Robot Arms 2.0 — next-gen palletizing arms.

Phase 1 — Prove (pallet cells): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (arm logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (mixed cases): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (vision): arm hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and warehouses-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
